title: Desktop fixes from the first story recording: company placeholder, trip passenger phone, live lead activity, local dates for timestamps, tenant itinerary templates, trip detail formatting
goal: Remove every app flaw that showed up on camera in the first full story take (desktop/showcase/TravelCRM-Demo.mp4, 10:57) so the re-record needs no workarounds.
context: Added by the orchestrator 2026-10-07 from the showcase part-2a hand-off and its frames (desktop/showcase/.work/story-take1/sheets/*.png in the MAIN checkout C:/Users/Admin/Downloads/pro/CRM - read s03.png and s05.png). The demo tenant is Sahyadri Holidays, user Ananya Menon; seed with `node --no-warnings backend/scripts/seed-demo.mjs`. Baselines: desktop tsc 0, unit 1241, lint 0 errors in src, build ok. Shared APIs: desktop/audit/fix/W6-CONTEXT.md (`@/lib/dates` formatDisplayDate / parseLocalDate / toLocalDateString, PhoneInput stores E.164, SendMessageDialog `variables`, useApiQuery `silent` refetch, ListPage refreshKey). A backend batch (B37) is concurrently making server-side today tenant-local; a later backend batch will normalise trip passenger phones server-side and apply numbering prefixes - you fix the DESKTOP side only and never edit backend/.
steps: (1) {{company_name}} placeholder: POST /auth/login returns no tenant object, so SendMessageDialog cannot resolve the company name and shows the placeholders-need-values warning for the stock Quotation Email template (itinerary -> Share -> Send via Email). Resolve the company name on the desktop from the company profile the app already has an endpoint for (find it: settings/company page -> its API client), cache it (store or a small hook, e.g. useCompanyProfile), and feed company_name / company_phone / company_email / agent_name / agent_email into SendMessageDialog's built-in variables everywhere it is used. With the demo data the Quotation Email must have ZERO unresolved placeholders when opened from an itinerary.

(2) Trip passenger phone: the trip form's PhoneInput drops the country code - a trip stores 9820144562 instead of +919820144562 (compare how the contact form and the fleet/drivers form wire PhoneInput). Fix new + edit (edit must show the stored number correctly whether it is E.164 or legacy digits), and display it formatted on trip detail and the trips list (+91 98201 44562).

(3) Lead detail: after a status change or a new note on the same page, the Activity tab still shows the old list until reload. Refetch the activity/timeline (and the related lists) after every mutation on the page (status, note, follow-up scheduled, assignment, message sent via SendMessageDialog).

(4) Timestamps shown as the UTC date: lead detail (Created 6 Oct at 01:xx IST on 7 Oct), invoice detail/list and others slice the ISO timestamp instead of converting to local time. Sweep desktop/src for places that render a server TIMESTAMP as a date (patterns: .slice(0, 10), .split('T')[0], substring(0, 10) on created_at / updated_at / sent_at and similar; parseLocalDate(<timestamp>); new Date(x).toISOString() for display) and render them with a local conversion helper (add formatDisplayDateTime and/or make formatDisplayDate accept full ISO timestamps and convert to local; date-only YYYY-MM-DD values must keep the parseLocalDate path so they do not shift). Unit-test both kinds under TZ=Asia/Kolkata at 2026-10-06T19:30:00Z (01:00 IST on 7 Oct) and under America/Los_Angeles.

(5) Trip detail formatting: the schedule shows raw 2026-10-07 14:45 strings; format start/end as 7 Oct 2026, 2:45 pm (en-IN) and show the duration; make sure every label on the page is human (no snake_case, no raw enums).

(6) Trip-not-found flash: one transient Trip not found was seen on a trip detail page right after navigating to it. Investigate the detail page's loading/error logic (and the 10s silent polling): a failed or in-flight refetch must never replace a loaded trip with a not-found state; a genuine 404 on first load shows the not-found state only after the request settles (no flash while loading). Add a unit or e2e check.

(7) Itinerary from-template: the create-from-template dialog lists only built-in templates; templates created on /itineraries/templates (API templates, the seed has 10) are not offered. List the tenant's templates (with search), and creating from one must copy its days/items. Keep any built-in starters after the tenant's own.

(8) Skeleton hygiene on the pages the story visits (lead detail, itinerary detail/edit, invoice detail, trip detail, fleet dashboard, dashboard, reports hub): no layout jump between skeleton and content (skeletons match the final layout height) so a frame caught mid-load still looks intentional.

Update or add specs for (2), (3), (7) in the owning spec files; run the gates; look at lead detail, the itinerary share dialog, trip new/detail and the invoice list in screenshots (seeded demo data, light, 1920x1080).
